headline: Colonial Surges Recapture Godcrofts And Linn As Northern Clashes Intensify
war_summary: A swift reversal across maritime and inland sectors has dramatically altered the front since the previous dispatch, headlined by Godcrofts swinging entirely into Colonial control (9–0) amid twenty base transitions over the past two hours. In Linn of Mercy, Colonial forces consolidated full possession of all eleven strategic strongholds, though casualty lists mounted steeply with over eleven hundred losses in the last two hours. Across Weathered Expanse, Colonial forces widened their margin to a 6–3 foothold, sustaining severe engagements that consumed more than two thousand men since noon. Farranac Coast suddenly reignited with five rapid base events centered on The Bone Haft and Transient Valley, leaving Wardens holding a single post alongside one ruined neutral territory. Further east, Stlican Shelf tightened to a narrow 5–4 Warden majority following three fresh turnovers. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage persists as an accelerating meat-grinder with over two thousand casualties in two hours despite unchanged lines, whereas Mooring County and Stonecradle have settled into temporary pauses in direct base turnover.
